scripts.test: pnpm run test:jsdom && pnpm run test:servo
scripts.benchmark:jsdom: vitest run --config vitest.jsdom.config.js test/large-form.jsdom.test.jsx --reporter=json --testNamePattern="large React form performance"
scripts.benchmark:servo: vitest run test/large-form.browser.test.jsx --reporter=json --testNamePattern="large React form performance"
